Arcanine Intimidate + Rotom-Wash Levitate is the key lead pairing to neutralize Metagross's Earthquake and burn it with Will-O-Wisp. Avoid leading Garchomp into Metagross due to Ice Punch SE. Tinkaton Fake Out is valuable for free damage but weak to Earthquake; save for later if needed. Starmie Analytic + Focus Band can handle Conkeldurr with Psychic SE if needed.

reflections.summary: Won because the opponent omitted Farigiraf, leaving their slow Trick Room core (Metagross-Mega, Goodra-Hisui, Sinistcha, Primarina) exposed to being outsped. Blaziken's Speed Boost let it outpace and eliminate Sinistcha, while Garchomp's Life Orb Earthquake cleaned up Goodra-Hisui and Primarina. Arcanine's Intimidate softened physical hits throughout.
reflections.adjustment: Expect Farigiraf next game to enable Trick Room. Bring a faster Taunt user or rely on Blaziken's Speed Boost to overpower Trick Room turns; avoid stacking slow attackers that become liabilities once Trick Room is active.
reflections.notebook: Game 3: Opponent skipped Farigiraf, leaving slow TR core vulnerable. Blaziken Speed Boost is highly effective against this team. Opponent relies heavily on Protect stalling (Sinistcha, Goodra, Primarina all used Protect multiple times). Goodra-Hisui runs Shell Armor + Leftovers + Draco Meteor, making it hard to chip without super-effective hits. Primarina runs Life Orb + Torrent, hits hard but is slow. Metagross-Mega ran Brave, confirming TR commitment. Opponent's bench includes Conkeldurr (Expert Belt, IronFist) as an alternative physical attacker.

reflections.summary: The game was lost because the opponent successfully preserved Garchomp and Rotom-Wash in the back while trading their more expendable threats (Arcanine, Blaziken) to eliminate our key special attackers. Our team lacked sufficient speed control and spread pressure to punish the opponent's Protect cycles and Speed Boost setup. The final turn double Protect failure left Primarina and Arcanine vulnerable to Garchomp's Earthquake, sealing the loss.
reflections.adjustment: Bring a faster mode or speed control (e.g., Tailwind, Icy Wind) to outpace Blaziken and Garchomp. Consider leading with a spread move user or Fake Out to disrupt the opponent's early Protect and Speed Boost sequencing. Against this opponent's tendency to Protect Blaziken at low HP, prioritize spread moves or double-targeting to force KOs through Protect.
